question: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution has the Appropriation Bill (No.2), 2025, been passed in Parliament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 114**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Appropriation Bill (No.2), 2025** is passed in **Parliament** under the provisions of **Article 114** of the **Constitution of India**.
 
• **Article 114** mandates that no money shall be withdrawn from the **Consolidated Fund of India** except under appropriation made by **law** passed in accordance with the provisions of this article.
 
• The **Appropriation Bill** is introduced in the **Lok Sabha** only after the **Demands for Grants** have been voted upon and passed by the house as per **Article 113**.
 
• This specific bill, **Appropriation Bill (No.2), 2025**, authorizes the **Government of India** to utilize funds for the **Financial Year 2025-26** to meet the expenditure charged on the **Consolidated Fund** and the grants made by the **Lok Sabha**.
